theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_bl_blowUp_restrict_scaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), MeasurableSet M → Measurable θ → 0 < lam → MeasurableSet (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M) ∧ μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) (μHE[n].restrict M) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) ((μHE[n].restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) = (μHE[n].restrict (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a lam '' M)).withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (θ (a + lam • y)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
